verdict.rationale: Evidence shows explicit versioned model IDs (e.g., 'meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct', 'llama-model download --model-id CHOSEN_MODEL_ID') and per-family model cards/licenses, but there is no mention anywhere of an alias mechanism that tracks the 'latest' release or any documented alias-to-version policy — model names appear to be fixed, explicit versions rather than mutable aliases.
